# Team Knowledge Hub (fixture bundle)

A minimal, valid OKF v0.2 bundle used by the plugin's tests. Three cards: one
`Practice`, one `Domain Knowledge` under a domain topic, one under the `aws`
topic (the shortest half-life in the shipped policy).

- `practices/data-boundary/mock-data-synthesis` — mock data must be synthetic
- `knowledge/domains/spot-market/intraday-price-shape` — needs recalibration
- `knowledge/aws/region-availability-probe` — availability must be probed
